title: Microsoft Launches Legal Skills Within Copilot, Furthering Move Into Legal Tech
key_facts: Microsoft announced Copilot for legal on Thursday 15 Oct 2026.
More than 20 purpose-built legal skills for its generative AI chatbot Copilot.
Two plugins: one for Microsoft Word, one for Microsoft Cowork.
Cowork is an agentic AI offering that performs tasks across Microsoft applications.
It evolves features unveiled in Microsoft's Legal Agent in April 2026.
Article text is a short excerpt; the skills themselves are not listed.
quote_evidence: Microsoft announced Thursday the launch of Copilot for legal, a set of more than 20 purpose-built legal skills for the company's generative artificial intelligence-powered chatbot.
The new offering consists of a pair of plugins, one for Microsoft Word and the other for Microsoft Cowork, an agentic AI offering that can perform tasks across Microsoft applications.
why_it_matters_hint: Brings AI legal work tools into software lawyers already use.
notes: Only the opening of the article was readable (paywall or excerpt), about 1,300 characters.
